clips.title: The story
paras: In Ironforge, Brandur Ironhammer guides young paladins in the Holy Light and sends them across the Alliance.

In the Hall of Mysteries, Brandur Ironhammer trains novice paladins in the ways of the Holy Light. He and Tiza Battleforge watch over young dwarven champions as they face the trials of the Tome of Divinity. Tiza has spoken frankly about Brandur’s personal flaws. He works to master his envy and keep the inner purity expected of a warrior of the Light.

Brandur connects Ironforge to the wider Alliance brotherhood. Human initiates who come to the dwarven mountain are sent south to Duthorian Rall in the Cathedral of Light. Seasoned paladins are directed to battlegrounds such as Chillwind Camp in the Western Plaguelands. Veteran crusaders are sent to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker for the demanding trials of the war charger.
